entities.name: José María Gil-Robles y Quiñones
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José María Gil-Robles y Quiñones de León was a Spanish politician, leader of the CEDA, Spain's first mass and modern right-wing party, and a prominent figure in the period leading up to the Spanish Civil War. Under his leadership at the age of 34, CEDA became the largest political party in the second republican Cortes (1933–1935) with just over one quarter of the seats.
